name: baseline-slide-lines
title: Baseline Slide Lines
description: Multi-line reveal where each line is its own clipped rail and slides up from below the baseline with per-line delay; line breaks are authored, so the composition survives font substitution.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Swiss
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- In View Trigger: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
